ai_summary: Aeroflex Neu Limited, a material subsidiary of Aeroflex Enterprises Limited, has approved the acquisition of an additional 31.43% equity stake in Stilonn Valves and Controls Private Limited for ₹16.00 crore, bringing its total ownership to 51.01% and making Stilonn a subsidiary. This strategic move aims to expand Aeroflex Neu's presence in high-growth AI infrastructure, data center, and critical healthcare sectors through Stilonn's precision engineering products. While the transaction is identified as a related party acquisition, the company affirms it is being undertaken on an arm's length basis.
